text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Grand celebrations will be held in Tikrit on Monday to mark President Saddam Hussein's birthday anniversary.
- Iraq holds the U.S. administration responsible for delaying the implementation of the oil-for-food deal with the United Nations.
- Russian parliament renews its support for Iraq's unity and sovereignty.
- Deputy Speaker of the Russian parliament leaves Baghdad.
(The above were also carried by QADISSIYA and JUMHOURIYA)
- Trade minister says more food imported under the oil-for-food deal arrives in Iraq.
